## Passages
RESULT [webresearch]: OpenScholar-8B beats GPT-4o by 5% and PaperQA2 by 7% on correctness (ScholarQABench: 2,967 expert queries). GPT-4o 'hallucinates citations 78 to 90% of the time', while OpenScholar's citation accuracy is on par with human experts. Experts preferred OpenScholar-8B over expert-written answers in 51% of comparisons (OpenScholar-GPT4o 70%, GPT-4o 32%).
US [webresearch]: Shows that a small open model can do grounded literature synthesis, provided it retrieves from a real paper index. Without retrieval even a frontier model fabricates most of its references. Rule for our loop: the brain never cites from memory, and every reference must resolve to an ID it actually fetched.
CORRECTION [webresearch]: '+5% over GPT-4o and +7% over PaperQA2' are the arXiv v1 figures.
